\documentclass[border=2pt]{standalone}
\usepackage{pgfplots}
\pgfplotsset{compat=1.18}
\begin{document}
\begin{tikzpicture}
  \begin{axis}[width=6cm,height=6cm,axis lines=middle,
    xmin=-4.4,xmax=4.4,ymin=-4.4,ymax=4.4,enlargelimits=false,
    max space between ticks=100,try min ticks=2,
    grid=major,grid style={dashed,gray!30},xlabel=$x$,ylabel=$y$]
    \addplot[blue,thick,domain=-4.4:4.4,samples=70] {x};
    \addplot[red,thick,domain=-4.4:4.4,samples=70] {2*sin(deg(x))};
  \end{axis}
\end{tikzpicture}
\end{document}
